scripts.desktop:dev: cd desktop && pnpm exec tauri dev
scripts.desktop:build: cd desktop && pnpm exec tauri build
scripts.mobile:sync: pnpm --filter @themashup/web build && cd mobile && pnpm run sync
scripts.mobile:apk: pnpm --filter @themashup/web build && cd mobile && pnpm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.mobile:apk:release: pnpm --filter @themashup/web build && cd mobile && pnpm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @themashup/shared test && pnpm --filter @themashup/api test && pnpm --filter @themashup/web test && bash scripts/test-resolver.sh
